storeInfo.name: Kawa Ni
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Japanese pub fare & ramen in the heart of Westport | Izakaya auténtico en Westport

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle Bridge St.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or Bridge St street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Edamame Salteado con Ajo y Chile
products.descriptionEs: Vainas de soja tiernas salteadas con ajo crujiente, aceite de chile picante y sal marina.
products.descriptionEn: Tender young soybeans tossed with crispy garlic, chili oil, and sea salt.

products.descriptionEs: Jugosos trozos de pollo marinados y fritos al estilo japonés, servidos con salsa alioli picante de yuzu.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy Japanese-style marinated and crispy fried chicken pieces, served with spicy yuzu aioli.
Pan-seared Japanese dumplings filled with savory pork and chives, served with house ponzu.
Marinated wakame seaweed, thinly sliced Japanese cucumber, and toasted sesame seeds in sweet sesame vinaigrette.
Rich and creamy 24-hour pork bone broth, handcrafted noodles, tender chashu pork, seasoned soft-boiled egg, and scallions.
Clear savory soy sauce-based broth, tender roasted chicken breast, seasoned bamboo shoots, nori, and fresh ramen noodles.
Aromatic shiitake mushroom and kombu broth, vegan noodles, braised tofu, baby bok choy, and a drizzle of black truffle oil.
Savory Japanese cabbage and pork belly pancake, topped with okonomiyaki sauce, Japanese mayo, and dancing bonito flakes.

products.nameEs: Buns de Panceta de Cerdo (Pork Belly Baos)
products.descriptionEn: Two fluffy steamed buns stuffed with melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly, house pickles, and sweet hoisin-sriracha drizzle.
Glazed salmon fillet with sweet house teriyaki sauce served over a bed of steamed rice with seasonal stir-fried greens.
Premium refined sake with delicate floral and light fruit notes, served chilled.
Traditional cold-brewed Japanese sencha green tea, refreshing and unsweetened.

products.descriptionEs: Bolas de masa crujientes rellenas de pulpo tierno, cubiertas con salsa especial, mayonesa japonesa y copos de bonito.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy batter balls filled with tender octopus, topped with special sauce, Japanese mayo, and bonito flakes.

products.descriptionEs: Tofu frito ligeramente crujiente servido en un caldo dashi sabroso con jengibre rallado y cebollino.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly crispy deep-fried tofu served in a savory dashi broth with grated ginger and scallions.

products.descriptionEs: Atún sellado rápidamente con una costra de sésamo, servido con salsa ponzu cítrica.
products.descriptionEn: Quickly seared tuna with a sesame crust, served with a citrusy ponzu sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Dos brochetas de muslo de pollo a la parrilla glaseadas con nuestra salsa tare secreta.
products.descriptionEn: Two grilled chicken thigh skewers glazed with our secret tare sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Ensalada refrescante de algas marinas sazonadas con aceite de sésamo y vinagre de arroz.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing seaweed salad seasoned with sesame oil and rice vinegar.

products.descriptionEs: Caldo rico de miso con fideos artesanales, cerdo chashu, huevo marinado y pasta de chile casera.
products.descriptionEn: Rich miso broth with artisanal noodles, chashu pork, marinated egg, and house-made chili paste.

products.descriptionEs: Chuleta de pollo empanada y crujiente servida sobre arroz al vapor con salsa de curry japonés suave.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy breaded chicken cutlet served over steamed rice with mild Japanese curry sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Tiras de ternera Wagyu salteadas con cebolla dulce sobre un tazón de arroz japonés.
products.descriptionEn: Slices of Wagyu beef sautéed with sweet onions over a bowl of Japanese rice.

products.descriptionEs: Fideos udon gruesos en caldo dashi vegetal con una variedad de verduras de temporada.
products.descriptionEn: Thick udon noodles in a vegetable dashi broth with an assortment of seasonal vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Fideos de trigo sarraceno servidos fríos con una salsa para mojar y tempura de gambas y verduras.
products.descriptionEn: Buckwheat noodles served cold with a dipping sauce and shrimp and vegetable tempura.

products.descriptionEs: Selección premium de pescado fresco del día, cortado expertamente por nuestro chef.
products.descriptionEn: Premium selection of fresh fish of the day, expertly sliced by our chef.

products.descriptionEs: Langostinos frescos rebozados en una masa ligera y crujiente, servidos con salsa tentsuyu.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh shrimp battered in a light, crispy tempura batter, served with tentsuyu sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Berenjena asada a la parrilla con un glaseado dulce y salado de miso rojo.
products.descriptionEn: Grilled eggplant roasted with a sweet and savory red miso glaze.

products.descriptionEs: Flan de huevo al vapor delicado con gambas, setas shiitake y ginkgo.
products.descriptionEn: Delicate steamed egg custard with shrimp, shiitake mushrooms, and ginkgo nuts.

products.descriptionEs: Sake sin filtrar, dulce y cremoso, perfecto para acompañar platos picantes.
products.descriptionEn: Unfiltered, sweet, and creamy sake, perfect for pairing with spicy dishes.

products.descriptionEs: Cerveza japonesa clásica, refrescante y ligera, ideal para izakaya.
products.descriptionEn: Classic Japanese beer, refreshing and light, perfect for izakaya dining.

products.descriptionEs: Té refrescante con el sabor cítrico único del yuzu japonés.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing tea infused with the unique citrus flavor of Japanese yuzu.

products.descriptionEs: Bebida japonesa carbonatada con un sabor lácteo suave y refrescante.
products.descriptionEn: Japanese carbonated drink with a mild, refreshing milky flavor.

products.descriptionEs: Té oolong tradicional, perfecto para limpiar el paladar después de la comida.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional oolong tea, perfect for cleansing the palate after a meal.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, disponemos de ramen vegano, edamame y opciones que pueden adaptarse con previo aviso a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegan ramen, edamame, and items that can be modified upon request to your server.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación (walk-ins) y reservaciones por teléfono para grupos pequeños y grandes.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations for both small and large parties.
